list.title: Stock movements
list.description: Every receipt and issue is recorded here. Stock on hand is calculated from these movements alone.

description.in: Record material received from a supplier.
description.out: Record material issued to production or written off.
description.adjustment: Record the difference found during a stock take.

form.unitHint: Stock is held in {{symbol}} — another unit is converted automatically.
form.adjustmentHint: Positive to add, negative to remove.
form.reasonRequired: A reason is required when stock leaves.
form.unitPriceHint: Recording it adds a row to the price history automatically.
form.positive: Quantity must be greater than zero.
form.batchNumberPlaceholder: Left blank the system issues one
form.batchNumberHint: Reusing a number adds to the existing lot.
form.expiryAutoHint: Left blank it is dated from the {{days}}-day shelf life.
form.fefoHint: This material is batch tracked — the issue is split automatically, earliest expiry first.

rowActions.reverseDescription: The movement is not deleted — a mirror adjustment is appended and both stay in the history.

lowStock.title: Materials needing an order
lowStock.empty: Every material is above its reorder point.
